title: Payment routes + procurement readiness (PO vs Card vs Marketplace) — SOC 2/DPA gating
text:
Payment routes + procurement readiness (PO vs Card vs Marketplace) — SOC 2/DPA gating

['From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Morris <jake.morris@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + procurement questions for Redwood

Karthik — thanks for the demo earlier today. A quick follow-up from our side on procurement and security so we can map timelines internally:

- Payment: we typically do enterprise purchases via PO (net 30), but have an internal card for small quick pilots. Would you accept a PO for an initial 12 month Dedicated capacity?
- Marketplace: curious if purchasing via AWS Marketplace would simplify our approval (and if pricing/discounts differ).
- Security: our InfoSec team requires SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA. Can you share the SOC 2 report and a DPA draft we can send to our reviewers? Also need to know if you accept answers to a standard security questionnaire (we use a 50–70 Q vendor form).

If you can send the SOC2 + DPA and a short note on the PO vs marketplace tradeoffs, I’ll loop procurement and get an ETA on their review. Thanks — Claire

--
Claire Bennett
Director, Digital Platforms
Orbital Health
claire.bennett@orbitalhealth.com
(415) 555-0194', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Jake Morris <jake.morris@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement questions for Redwood

Claire — great to meet you today, and thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Attachments: SOC2_report_redwood_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft.docx

Short answers:
- PO vs Card: We accept PO (Net 30) for Dedicated and Enterprise contracts. For smaller pilots under $10k we’ve seen customers use corporate card to speed onboarding.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace can speed legal sign-off for some customers because billing and terms are standardized, but feature parity is the same; pricing/discounts can differ (marketplace fees apply). If procurement requires AWS Marketplace, we can route that — it may add a week for marketplace listing and billing setup.
- Security questionnaire: yes — we can complete a standard vendor questionnaire. For complex items we’ll escalate to our security team.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) I’ll send the SOC 2 report and DPA draft (attached) today.
2) Orbital to confirm preferred payment path (PO vs marketplace vs card) by 11/3.
3) If PO: procurement sends required fields (PO template + signature authority) and we surface standard invoice terms.
4) Security: Orbital sends the vendor questionnaire by 11/5; Redwood will return answers within 3 business days for the standard 50–70 Q form.

If that looks good I’ll loop in Marissa (Commercial) and Prio (Proc Ops) so we can align discounts and billing.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0133', 'From: Jake Morris <jake.morris@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement questions for Redwood

Karthik / Claire — thanks. A couple of procurement specifics from our side:

- Preference: PO (net 30) is preferred for new vendors.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report + completed questionnaire. We will start with a 10–day review window once we have those.
- PO details: our PO needs supplier legal name, remit to address, and invoicing email. Any contract redlines will need to go through our legal team.

Quick question: does Redwood accept invoices by email or do you require ACH details in the PO? Also confirm whether Redwood can sign our standard DPA or whether you require Redwood’s DPA language.

—Jake
Procurement Manager
Orbital Health
procurement@orbitalhealth.com', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@orbitalhealth.com>, Jake Morris <jake.morris@orbitalhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro + procurement questions for Redwood

Looping in commercial to outline options and timing. High level notes for internal alignment before Karthik replies to Orbital:

- Pricing/discounts: For a 12m Dedicated commitment we can offer standard tiered discount (we’ll populate numbers in Commercial_worksheet_Orbital.xlsx). If they buy via AWS Marketplace, discounting is limited and we need to adjust list pricing to account for marketplace fees.
- PO terms: We accept PO/net-30 for Dedicated deals; finance needs supplier remit and invoicing details to generate invoices. We can accept emailed invoices to invoicing@redwood.ai and support ACH/ACH+wire as needed.
- DPA: We generally start from Redwood_DPA_draft.docx. If Orbital returns their DPA we’ll compare and try to minimize redlines.
- Security questionnaire: we will complete their 50–70 Q form. For items requiring technical evidence (e.g., rotational key proofs, KMS details, SOC 2 control narratives), hand off to InfoSec; expect 3–5 business days once they receive the questionnaire.

Action for Karthik: confirm marketplace vs PO preference to Claire + Jake, and attach the commercial worksheet (I’ve attached a draft). I’ll prepare invoice template and finance contact details once they pick PO.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: Commercial_worksheet_Orbital.xlsx', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@orbitalhealth.com>, Jake Morris <jake.morris@orbitalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement questions for Redwood

Claire/Jake — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming next steps and answering the outstanding items below.

Key confirms:
- We accept a PO for the 12m Dedicated commitment on Net 30. Finance accepts emailed invoices to invoicing@redwood.ai; we can include ACH details on the invoice.
- DPA: we can sign the Redwood DPA (attached earlier) or review Orbital’s DPA; for speed we’ll offer DocuSign for the Redwood DPA link here: https://app.redwood/docusign/dpa/RDW-ORBIT-57
- Marketplace: if you prefer AWS Marketplace to centralize procurement, note there is ~1 week for marketplace setup and fees apply which slightly changes the list-to-customer price. If fastest procurement is the goal and Orbital procurement accepts marketplace terms, that route is an option.
- Security questionnaire: please send the vendor questionnaire by 11/05; Redwood will complete and return within 3 business days for the standard 50–70 Q set. For any items requiring control evidence we’ll include SOC2_control_narratives and point to SOC2_report_redwood_2025.pdf (attached previously).

Proposed mutual action plan (finalized):
1) 11/01: Orbital confirms payment path (PO vs Marketplace vs Card) — Claire to confirm.
2) 11/03: If PO, Orbital sends PO template + remit/signer details; Redwood returns invoice template and finance contact.
3) 11/05: Orbital sends security questionnaire; Redwood returns completed questionnaire by 11/10 and provides SOC2 report + control narratives.
4) 11/08–11/12: Legal review window for any DPA redlines; if none, execute DPA via DocuSign.

I’ll wait on Claire’s call on payment path and will get procurement/finance details to Jake once they confirm PO. If you want Marissa or Priyom to join a short call this week to accelerate, we can set up a 20-minute slot.

Best,
Karthik
